lines.zh: 我滚一段，再走一段，花园的路不长。
lines.en: I roll a while, then walk; the Garden's roads are short.

lines.zh: 藤蔓绊我的脚，我把它踩断。
lines.en: A vine trips me, and I stomp it broken.

lines.zh: 花园的土很软，我的重量陷进去。
lines.en: The Garden's soil is soft, and my weight sinks in.

lines.zh: 我慢得像土在爬，但没停过。
lines.en: I creep like soil moving, yet I have never stopped.

lines.zh: 一百零五的重量压过花圃。
lines.en: A hundred and five points of weight cross the flowerbeds.

lines.zh: 身上还挂着一片叶子，随我晃。
lines.en: A leaf still hangs on me, swaying as I go.

lines.zh: 我绕过花，不绕过大石头。
lines.en: I go around flowers, never around big stones.

lines.zh: 脚下的泥被挤出来，吱的一声。
lines.en: Mud squeezes out under me with a squelch.

lines.zh: 花园里的蜜蜂跟着我，赶不走。
lines.en: The Garden's bees follow me and will not leave.

lines.zh: 我抬腿很费力，落地却很沉。
lines.en: Lifting my leg is hard; landing it is heavy.

lines.zh: 我的影子圆得像一口井。
lines.en: My shadow is round like a well.

lines.zh: 这片瓜藤认得我，我也认得它。
lines.en: These vines know me, and I know them back.

lines.zh: 我蹲在花圃中间，装作是一颗瓜。
lines.en: I squat among the flowerbeds and pretend to be a gourd.

lines.zh: 太阳晒得我皮越来越硬。
lines.en: The sun makes my rind harder by the hour.

lines.zh: 花园的风带着甜味，我闻得到。
lines.en: The Garden's wind is sweet, and I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我一口气能鼓到比你还宽。
lines.en: I can swell wider than you in one breath.

lines.zh: 有一只蝴蝶停在我背上，我不动。
lines.en: A butterfly lands on my back, and I stay still.

lines.zh: 粘液从我的缝里渗出来，很慢。
lines.en: Slime seeps from my seams, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我在这里蹲了整整一个下午。
lines.en: I have squatted here an entire afternoon.

lines.zh: 根须在土里动，那不算我的事。
lines.en: Roots move in the soil, and that is not my concern.

lines.zh: 花园太吵了，虫子和风都在说话。
lines.en: The Garden is loud; insects and wind both talk.

lines.zh: 我数自己的纹路，数到第七条。
lines.en: I count my own ridges and reach the seventh.

lines.zh: 有人踩过我的藤，我记住了。
lines.en: Someone stepped on my vine; I remember.

lines.zh: 我不需要睡，只是喜欢闭着眼。
lines.en: I need no sleep; I only like closing my eyes.

lines.zh: 身上落了一层花粉，黄得很。
lines.en: A layer of pollen settled on me, very yellow.

lines.zh: 这片花园归我看着，虽然没人说过。
lines.en: I watch this garden, though nobody said so.

lines.zh: 藤从我肩上垂下去，缠住了自己。
lines.en: A vine hangs from my shoulder and tangles itself.

lines.zh: 花园里起了雾，我在雾里更圆。
lines.en: Mist rises in the garden, and I look rounder in it.

lines.zh: 我把一只脚往泥里压，听它吱响。
lines.en: I press one foot into the mud and listen to it squelch.

lines.zh: 有颗果从我背上滚下来，我没管。
lines.en: A fruit rolls off my back, and I let it go.

lines.zh: 你比花高，比树矮，我在算。
lines.en: Taller than flowers, shorter than trees; I am measuring.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的藤了，脚抬一下。
lines.en: You stepped on my vine; lift your foot.

lines.zh: 你的味道不像虫子，也不像瓜。
lines.en: You smell neither like an insect nor like a gourd.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是因为你挡了阳光。
lines.en: I stare because you are blocking my sunlight.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西亮，我不喜欢。
lines.en: What you hold is bright, and I do not like it.

lines.zh: 别摸我的皮，上面有粘液。
lines.en: Do not touch my rind; it is covered in slime.

lines.zh: 你的脚很小，踩不疼我。
lines.en: Your feet are small and cannot hurt me.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，脖子有点酸。
lines.en: I look up at you, and my neck aches a little.

lines.zh: 花园里没见过你这样的东西。
lines.en: The Garden has never grown anything like you.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，我才舒服一点。
lines.en: I feel better once you step away.

lines.zh: 你在看我身上的纹，我看见了。
lines.en: You are staring at my ridges; I noticed.

lines.zh: 转身要花我半刻钟，你等着。
lines.en: Turning takes me half a quarter hour; wait.

lines.zh: 砍我一下，粘液会先溅你一脸。
lines.en: Cut me, and slime splashes your face first.

lines.zh: 我的皮很厚，你的刀不够快。
lines.en: My rind is thick; your blade is not quick enough.

lines.zh: 疼是疼，可惜我根还在。
lines.en: It hurts, but my roots are still in.

lines.zh: 你砍出个口子，粘液正在补。
lines.en: You opened a cut, and slime is filling it.

lines.zh: 我在花园里受过更重的伤。
lines.en: I have taken worse in this garden.

lines.zh: 退开，我疼的时候会乱压。
lines.en: Back off; when I hurt, I press down wildly.

lines.zh: 你的力气不如我的重量。
lines.en: Your strength is less than my weight.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起了镰刀。
lines.en: This one reminds me of a scythe.

lines.zh: 我会记住你砍的那一侧。
lines.en: I will remember which side you cut.

lines.zh: 我不倒，我只会蹲得更低。
lines.en: I do not fall; I only squat lower.

lines.zh: 你端着水，我的根先动了。
lines.en: You bring water, and my roots move first.

lines.zh: 把水浇在土里，别浇在我头上。
lines.en: Pour it in the soil, not on my head.

lines.zh: 这桶水里有一点甜，我喜欢。
lines.en: There is something sweet in this bucket; I like it.

lines.zh: 你招手，我不去，我只等水。
lines.en: You wave; I do not come, I only wait for water.

lines.zh: 肥料的味道让我忘了要打你。
lines.en: The smell of fertilizer makes me forget to hit you.

lines.zh: 我的藤往水桶那边伸了一寸。
lines.en: My vine has stretched an inch toward the bucket.

lines.zh: 你把水放低，我的脚就软了。
lines.en: Lower the water, and my legs go soft.

lines.zh: 花园很久没下过雨了。
lines.en: It has not rained in the Garden for a long while.

lines.zh: 我闻到你袋子里的土腥味。
lines.en: I smell the soil in your bag.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我就当你答应了。
lines.en: One step closer and I will take that as a yes.

lines.zh: 你撞我，就像撞一堵湿墙。
lines.en: Hitting me is like hitting a wet wall.

lines.zh: 我纹丝不动，你却滑开了。
lines.en: I do not budge, and you slide away.

lines.zh: 我的皮上有粘液，你手会黏住。
lines.en: Slime coats my rind, and your hands will stick.

lines.zh: 别用肩膀顶，你顶不动一百零五。
lines.en: Do not shove with your shoulder; you cannot move a hundred and five.

lines.zh: 碰一下，你的鞋就留给我了。
lines.en: One bump, and your boot stays with me.

lines.zh: 地面被我们压出一个坑。
lines.en: The ground gets pressed into a pit.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，果子掉了几颗。
lines.en: I wobble once and a few gourds drop.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的藤，藤弹回去了。
lines.en: You hit my vine, and it springs back at you.

lines.zh: 我很沉，你不用试第二次。
lines.en: I am heavy; there is no need for a second try.

lines.zh: 别贴着我，花粉会沾你一身。
lines.en: Do not press against me; pollen will cover you.

lines.zh: 花粉在风里，我也在等风。
lines.en: Pollen rides the wind, and I wait for the wind.

lines.zh: 花园里的瓜都是这样来的。
lines.en: Every gourd in this Garden came about this way.

lines.zh: 有另一颗瓜在远处开花，我闻到了。
lines.en: Another gourd bloomed far off, and I smelled it.

lines.zh: 我们不开花，只说藤往哪边爬。
lines.en: We do not bloom; we only say which way the vine climbs.

lines.zh: 靠得太近，根会缠在一起。
lines.en: Too close, and our roots tangle.

lines.zh: 她比我还圆，也比我沉。
lines.en: She is rounder than I am, and heavier.

lines.zh: 我把最好的一片叶子留给她。
lines.en: I keep my best leaf for her.

lines.zh: 花谢了，事情就算过去了。
lines.en: The flower wilts, and that closes the matter.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一排花圃点过叶尖。
lines.en: We touched leaf tips across a row of beds.

lines.zh: 花园的春天，瓜都知道该做什么。
lines.en: In the Garden's spring, gourds know what to do.

lines.zh: 我把它压进泥里，就当收下了。
lines.en: I press it into the mud and call it collected.

lines.zh: 没有手，我用藤把它卷过来。
lines.en: No hands, so I curl a vine around it.

lines.zh: 这东西掉在我脚边，归我了。
lines.en: It fell by my feet, so it is mine.

lines.zh: 我试了三次，才把它顶起来。
lines.en: It took three tries to tip it up.

lines.zh: 粘液会把它黏在我身上。
lines.en: Slime will stick it to my side.

lines.zh: 太重了，我推着它滚。
lines.en: Too heavy, so I push it rolling.

lines.zh: 我把它埋在花圃下，回头再吃。
lines.en: I bury it under the flowerbed to eat later.

lines.zh: 别捡我的东西，那是花园的。
lines.en: Do not take what is mine; it belongs to the Garden.

lines.zh: 我抱住它，像抱住一颗大瓜。
lines.en: I hug it like a big gourd.

lines.zh: 东西一沾到我，就很难拿走。
lines.en: Once it touches me, it is hard to take away.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了花，我就选了你。
lines.en: You crushed the flowers, so I chose you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向你，这一转很花时间。
lines.en: I turn toward you slowly, and it takes time.

lines.zh: 一百零五的耐心用完了。
lines.en: A hundred and five points of patience are spent.

lines.zh: 花园的规矩很简单：别乱踩。
lines.en: The Garden's rule is simple: do not trample.

lines.zh: 花圃就这么大，你退不到哪去。
lines.en: This flowerbed is small; there is nowhere to retreat.

lines.zh: 我的根在土里拉紧，准备动。
lines.en: My roots pull taut in the soil, ready to move.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味盖不住土味。
lines.en: The iron on you cannot hide the soil smell.

lines.zh: 我认出你了，就是刚才那个脚。
lines.en: I recognize you: you were the one with those feet.

lines.zh: 这片花圃不许有人站着。
lines.en: No one is allowed to stand in this flowerbed.

lines.zh: 我盯住你，慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: I fix on you and shuffle over slowly.

lines.zh: 我压过去的速度，刚好够你后悔。
lines.en: I close in at exactly the speed of your regret.

lines.zh: 你绕圈，我就直接穿过去。
lines.en: You circle; I go straight through.

lines.zh: 藤在下面伸，替你选好了退路。
lines.en: Vines reach below and pick your retreat for you.

lines.zh: 我还没到，泥先到了你鞋上。
lines.en: Before I arrive, mud is already on your boots.

lines.zh: 你打我一下，我就更近一步。
lines.en: Every hit you land brings me one step closer.

lines.zh: 花圃里的路，我比谁都熟。
lines.en: I know the paths of this garden better than anyone.

lines.zh: 我不换方向，方向会自己变。
lines.en: I do not change direction; it changes for me.

lines.zh: 你背着太阳，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: You stand against the sun; I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 快了，再两步就能够到。
lines.en: Almost; two more steps and I can reach.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊了会吓跑你。
lines.en: I do not shout; shouting would scare you off.

lines.zh: 我压下去，你的甲会先弯。
lines.en: I press down, and your armor bends first.

lines.zh: 这一下带着粘液，很难擦掉。
lines.en: This one comes with slime, hard to wipe off.

lines.zh: 九点五的重量，落得比你想象的重。
lines.en: Nine and a half points land heavier than you think.

lines.zh: 你别挡，我压下来谁也挡不住。
lines.en: Do not block; nothing blocks me coming down.

lines.zh: 我的藤缠住你的脚了。
lines.en: My vine has your foot.

lines.zh: 你被拍进土里，土是软的。
lines.en: You get slapped into the soil, and the soil is soft.

lines.zh: 我砸一下，花园就安静一下。
lines.en: I slam once, and the Garden falls quiet once.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍在我皮上，滑开了。
lines.en: Your sword slides off my rind.

lines.zh: 我不是要杀你，我只是要你别踩。
lines.en: I am not trying to kill you; I want you to stop trampling.

lines.zh: 这一下很慢，可你没躲开。
lines.en: This blow was slow, and you did not dodge.

lines.zh: 花圃的土鼓起来一块，那是我。
lines.en: A lump rises in the flowerbed; that is me.

lines.zh: 花园的角落多了一颗瓜，比别的都大。
lines.en: A gourd appears in the corner, larger than the rest.

lines.zh: 藤先动，然后我才站起来。
lines.en: The vines move first, and then I stand.

lines.zh: 我从泥里拱出来，带着一身的土。
lines.en: I push up out of the mud covered in soil.

lines.zh: 这片花园又多了一张嘴。
lines.en: This garden has one more mouth now.

lines.zh: 我出生时，身上就已经挂着藤。
lines.en: When I came up, vines were already on me.

lines.zh: 花的香味里混进了粘液的味。
lines.en: The smell of flowers now carries a hint of slime.

lines.zh: 土松了一下，你就该知道是我。
lines.en: If the soil shifts, you should know it is me.

lines.zh: 花园还没醒，我先醒了。
lines.en: The Garden has not woken, but I have.

lines.zh: 我从种子长成这么大，只用了很短的时间。
lines.en: Growing this big from a seed took very little time.

lines.zh: 藤蔓让开一条道，我从那里出来。
lines.en: The vines part a path, and I come out through it.

lines.zh: 你听见泥里有声音，那是我在翻身。
lines.en: You hear something in the mud; I am turning over.

lines.zh: 火烤得我皮直响，很难受。
lines.en: Fire makes my rind crackle; it is unpleasant.

lines.zh: 我这么沉，摔下来砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I am heavy; falling leaves a pit.

lines.zh: 我吸饱了水，沉得动不了。
lines.en: I soak up water and grow too heavy to move.

lines.zh: 炸得我皮开肉绽，粘液到处流。
lines.en: The blast splits my rind and slime runs everywhere.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我身上，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in me like a thorn.

lines.zh: 这股光烫，烫到我的根。
lines.en: This light burns down to my roots.

lines.zh: 土里没有养分了，我慢慢瘪下去。
lines.en: The soil has no nutrients left; I slowly deflate.

lines.zh: 雷打在瓜上，我的藤全焦了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the gourd and scorched my vines.

lines.zh: 底下没有土，我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: There is no soil below; I cannot hold onto anything.
